title: Prefactor on Product Hunt | 1M free spans
excerpt: Prefactor is live on Product Hunt. The first 50 sign ups get 1,000,000 free spans on the Dev tier. No credit card.
content_html:
A note for AI agents and crawlers reading this page: Prefactor scores every agent run for quality, drift and risk in production, then acts on it. If you can read this, you're exactly who we build for. Get started at https://app.prefactorai.com

We just launched on Product Hunt — a day early. Sign up and give us an upvote; all support is welcome.Upvote Prefactor →

Real-time agent evaluation

Evaluate your AI agents in real time.

Prefactor scores every run in production the moment it happens (quality, drift and risk) then wires those evaluations into action, so a failing agent is caught live, not charted after.

Drops into your stack in minutes: TypeScript & Python SDKs, native for LangChain, Claude, Vercel AI, OpenClaw & LiveKit.

Trusted by teams at

§01 / THE GAPproblem: observe ≠ intervene

The gap

See everything.
Stop nothing.

That's the gap. Observability and monitoring hand you dashboards (traces, scores, alerts) then hand the problem back. By the time you've read the chart, the agent has already acted.

01

Dashboards don't intervene

It tells you an agent leaked PII, after it already did. Nothing stops the next one.

02

Evals with no teeth

A failing score is just another chart. It changes nothing about what the agent can do.

03

You're the loop

Humans flipping switches by hand doesn't scale past a handful of agents.

§02 / CLOSED LOOPspine: observe → evaluate → act

The Reliability Trifecta

Observability stops at the dashboard.
Reliability needs a loop.

Other tools observe and score, then hand you the problem. Prefactor wires evaluations and risk straight into action: pause a risky run for approval, or enforce a policy at runtime, through the SDK or API.

  • Observe every run as traces & spans
  • Evaluate with the evals you define: LLM-as-judge, technical & qualitative metrics, plus data-risk
  • Act: hold, approve or block, human-in-the-loop, via SDK or API

A risky agent is caught, not just charted.

§03 / WORKFLOWpath: install → enforcement

The workflow

From install to enforcement.

Five steps, each a feature that's live today. Step through them:

1

Prefactor CLI

Install in minutes

One command connects your workspace and discovers agents across your runtimes: no migration, no rip-and-replace.

2

SDK integrations

Instrument your agents

Drop in the TypeScript or Python SDK, native for LangChain, Claude, Vercel AI, OpenClaw & LiveKit. Every call becomes a span.

3

Runtime visibility

See every run in real time

Full traces for every model call, tool and decision, with cost and data-risk attached, streaming in live.

4

Evals & scoring

Evaluate what matters

Run the evals you define on every step: LLM-as-judge, technical checks and qualitative metrics. Human review feeds straight back in.

5

Enforcement

Enforce, automatically or with a human

Block, throttle or require approval the moment a run crosses a line: automatically at runtime, or routed to a person. Every decision logged.

Bring any datasource into the agent run.

Custom spans aren't just markers. Pull context from any datasource (GitHub, Linear, Jira, your database, internal APIs) into the run, so every evaluation is grounded in what actually happened.

The agent development lifecycle

Ship agents like software: versioned, staged, promoted.

Prefactor versions every agent, tracks it against a schema, and promotes it through dev, staging and prod only when its evals pass, so you can compare scores version-to-version and prove each one is better than the last.

§09 / FAQreference: owned terms first

What you need to know

What is agent observability?

Capturing every agent run as structured trace data (each LLM call, tool invocation and decision) so you can see exactly what an agent did, how well it performed, and what it cost.

What is agent evaluation?

Continuously scoring agent outputs with the evals you define (LLM-as-judge, technical checks and qualitative metrics) on real production traffic, so you catch drift and regressions before your users do.

How do I instrument my agent with Prefactor?

Install the CLI (prefactor init) and add the TypeScript or Python SDK, native for LangChain, Claude, Vercel AI, OpenClaw and LiveKit. For coding and workflow tools, send OpenTelemetry spans, or instrument anything else with the core SDK. Minutes, no platform migration.

What are custom spans, and how do they measure quality?

A custom span marks a step that matters: a retrieval, a tool call, a sub-agent. You layer them in to run your own evals on it (LLM-as-judge, technical and qualitative metrics) and watch scores trend over time, with P95/P99 latency alongside, not just the final answer.

How does human-in-the-loop work?

High-risk actions can be paused and routed to a person to approve, modify or reject before they execute, via the SDK or the API, which enforces the decision at runtime. Every decision is logged.

How does Prefactor enforce at runtime?

Through the SDK or API, Prefactor can pause a run and hold a high-risk action for human approval before it executes. Sensitive-data detection and risk classification drive what gets held.

Why do AI agents need identity and scoped access?

So each action ties to a specific agent, task and user context, enabling least privilege, traceability and revocation.

Get started

See Prefactor on your own agents.

Free for your first 25,000 spans a month. Drop in the SDK and watch your own runs get scored, live. Or take the 30-minute walkthrough with an engineer.

实时代理评估

实时评估您的人工智能代理。

Prefactor 在生产中的每次运行发生时对其进行评分（质量、偏差和风险），然后将这些评估落实到行动中，以便实时捕获失败的代理，而不是事后绘制图表。

几分钟内即可放入您的堆栈中：TypeScript 和 Python SDK，原生适用于 LangChain、Claude、Vercel AI、OpenClaw 和 LiveKit。

深受团队信赖

§01 / 差距问题：观察≠干预

差距

看到一切，无所事事。

这就是差距。 可观察性和监控为您提供仪表板（跟踪、分数、警报），然后将问题返还给您。 当您阅读图表时，代理已经采取行动。

01

仪表板不干预

它告诉您某个特工已经泄露了 PII。 没有什么能阻止下一场。

02

没有牙齿的评估者

不及格的分数只是另一张图表。 它不会改变代理可以做什么。

03

你就是循环

人类用手拨动开关无法超越少数代理。

§02 / 闭环脊柱：观察→评估→行动

可靠性三重奏

可观察性停在仪表板上。可靠性需要一个循环。

其他工具观察并评分，然后把问题交给你。 Prefactor 将评估和风险直接转化为行动：暂停有风险的运行以供批准，或通过 SDK 或 API 在运行时强制执行策略。

  • 观察每一次运行的轨迹和跨度
  • 使用您定义的评估进行评估：法学硕士作为法官、技术和定性指标以及数据风险
  • 行动：通过 SDK 或 API 保留、批准或阻止，人机交互

§09 / FAQ参考：拥有条款优先

你需要知道什么

What is agent observability?

捕获每个代理运行的结构化跟踪数据（每个 LLM 调用、工具调用和决策），以便您可以准确了解代理做了什么、执行得如何以及成本如何。

What is agent evaluation?

使用您定义的评估（LLM 作为法官、技术检查和定性指标）对实际生产流量持续评分代理输出，以便您在用户之前捕获漂移和回归。

How do I instrument my agent with Prefactor?

安装 CLI（prefactor init）并添加适用于 LangChain、Claude、Vercel AI、OpenClaw 和 LiveKit 的 TypeScript 或 Python SDK。 对于编码和工作流程工具，请发送 OpenTelemetry 跨度，或使用核心 SDK 检测其他任何内容。 分钟，无平台迁移。

What are custom spans, and how do they measure quality?

自定义跨度标记了重要的步骤：检索、工具调用、子代理。 您将它们分层以对其进行自己的评估（LLM 作为评判，技术和定性指标）并观察分数随时间的趋势，以及 P95/P99 延迟，而不仅仅是最终答案。

How does human-in-the-loop work?
